calls.statement:
SELECT f.week_ending_date, count(*) n,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_value IS NULL OR f.closing_units IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_null,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.closing_value - f.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) val_mismatch,
 sum(f.closing_value) v, sum(f.closing_units) u,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.is_current THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) noncurrent_ver,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outside_valid
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND p.category='Paint & Decorating' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT s.store_id, p.sku FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-07-05' AND p.category='Paint & Decorating'),
b AS (SELECT s.store_id, p.sku FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-07-12' AND p.category='Paint & Decorating')
SELECT a.store_id, a.sku, cp.delisted_on FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (store_id, sku) LEFT JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=a.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE b.sku IS NULL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT f.week_ending_date, SUM(f.closing_value) AS week_value
    FROM fact_stock_week f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999
      AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(AVG(week_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_at_cost_eur, COUNT(*) AS weeks FROM weekly
